D/ FL IVL CON[---] ; R/ [GLO]R IAEXER C[ITVS]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, probably of Constantius II (323-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Laureate bust draped right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CON[---]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, a disc device on standard. Reverse inscription: [GLO]R IAEXER C[ITVS].
